title: refactor(invoices): rename _gross to _with_vat
body: The name _gross did not say which tax it adds, and we are about to add a second one. This renames it to _with_vat and updates both callers.
author: acme-dev

files.patch:
@@ -1,13 +1,13 @@
 VAT_RATE = 0.21
 
 
-def _gross(amount):
+def _with_vat(amount):
     return round(amount * (1 + VAT_RATE), 2)
 
 
 def line_total(qty, unit_price):
-    return _gross(qty * unit_price)
+    return _with_vat(qty * unit_price)
 
 
 def invoice_total(lines):
-    return sum(_gross(qty * price) for qty, price in lines)
+    return sum(_with_vat(qty * price) for qty, price in lines)
